title: Mizzen agent-edit provenance record
description: One line of an append-only edit ledger: the plan's file and span, the SHA-256 of the source before and after, the outcome, and the verification that followed. The cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot express, such as an applied outcome requiring an after hash and a rejected one requiring none, are checked by src/edits/audit.ts before a record is written. Records are one compact JSON object per line, keys in this order, with checks sorted by id. Free text is redacted: no credentials, environment dumps, or absolute machine-local paths.

id.description: SHA-256 over the plan's identity; the key that correlates a plan with its record.

outcome.description: How the plan ended. `rejected` means nothing was written to the source.

date.description: When the plan ended, ISO 8601 UTC. Omitted when neither the caller nor SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH supplied a date.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the source bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

path.description: A relative path with forward slashes: no leading slash, drive letter, backslash, or `..` segment.

span.description: One source span, 1-based lines and columns, the end inclusive.

line.description: Line where the replaced text starts.

column.description: Column where the replaced text starts, in Unicode code points.

endLine.description: Line where the replaced text ends.

endColumn.description: Column of the span's last character, inclusive.

plan.description: The plan the record is about: where it applied and the hashes on each side.

file.description: The source file, relative to the site root, with forward slashes.

beforeHash.description: SHA-256 of the whole source the plan was computed from.

afterHash.description: SHA-256 of the whole source after the plan; null when the plan was rejected.

check.description: One verification check. Its message is redacted before it is written.

id.description: A stable identifier for the check, such as `doctor.L1`.

message.description: What the check found, with credentials and machine-local paths redacted.

file.description: The file the check is about, relative to the site root, with forward slashes.

verification.description: The verification that followed a plan: its worst status and its checks, sorted by id. A skipped verification has no checks.

status.description: The worst status the checks support. `skipped` means no verification ran.

checks.description: The checks, sorted by id comparing code points, without duplicate ids.
